Thanks for the awesome experience. I was curious, and looked up if IVOY was AI generated music or not and Google AI got me the answer. AI-assisted, which is not unlike me and comedy -- I use AI mostly for feedback and helping figure out structures and organization of content. The words, ideas, all that are mine.

But I was just curious. So more of curator than a musician. I'm perfectly cool with that. A lot of people lose their shit over things that are no big deal. If someone wants the experience of creating a world, go for it, and honestly, this feels awesome, and it isn't plagued with ad interruptions, which I really appreciate. 

The relationships built with instruments in real life are way better, but maybe it can be a starting point using AI. Keep going. Plenty of time and life, anyone can learn and create anything. Maybe the IVOY person turns into a great pianist and releases original compositions someday. Music is the best relationship I ever had.
